# BuzzFeed
> BuzzFeed is a digital media site covering breaking news, entertainment, quizzes, videos, shopping, and Tasty recipes.

BuzzFeed publishes a mix of journalism, pop culture coverage, interactive content, food media, and lifestyle recommendations. Its site spans news reporting, celebrity and TV coverage, quizzes and games, shopping guides, and Tasty cooking content.

## Core Sections
- [BuzzFeed Home](https://www.buzzfeed.com/): Main homepage featuring trending stories, quizzes, entertainment, and news.
- [News](https://www.buzzfeed.com/news): BuzzFeed News coverage, reporting, and major current-events stories.
- [Quizzes](https://www.buzzfeed.com/quizzes): Hub for personality quizzes, trivia, and interactive formats.
- [Videos](https://www.buzzfeed.com/videos): Video content across entertainment, food, lifestyle, and social trends.
- [Shopping](https://www.buzzfeed.com/shopping): Product recommendations, gift guides, and commerce-focused articles.
- [Tasty](https://www.buzzfeed.com/tasty): Food and cooking section with recipes, tips, and kitchen inspiration.
- [As Is](https://www.buzzfeed.com/asis): Lifestyle and identity-focused content from BuzzFeed's As/Is brand.

## News & Reporting
- [BuzzFeed News](https://www.buzzfeed.com/news): Central news section for reporting, investigations, and current events.
- [World News](https://www.buzzfeed.com/world): International news coverage and global current-events stories.
- [Politics](https://www.buzzfeed.com/topic/politics): Political news, elections coverage, and policy-related reporting.
- [In The News](https://www.buzzfeed.com/in-the-news): Fast-moving stories and trending news topics.
- [Investigations](https://www.buzzfeed.com/investigations): Investigative reporting and accountability journalism.
- [Tech](https://www.buzzfeed.com/tech): Technology reporting, internet culture, and platform-related news.

## Entertainment & Culture
- [TV & Movies](https://www.buzzfeed.com/tvandmovies): Coverage of television, films, streaming, and fandom culture.
- [Celebrity](https://www.buzzfeed.com/celebrity): Celebrity news, interviews, reactions, and social-media moments.
- [Music](https://www.buzzfeed.com/music): Music coverage, artist-focused stories, and pop music features.
- [Books](https://www.buzzfeed.com/books): Book recommendations, reading lists, and literary culture coverage.
- [LGBTQ](https://www.buzzfeed.com/lgbtq): LGBTQ news, culture, identity, and community-focused stories.
- [Rewind](https://www.buzzfeed.com/rewind): Nostalgia-driven entertainment and throwback pop culture content.
- [Best of the Internet](https://www.buzzfeed.com/bestoftheinternet): Viral internet moments, memes, and online trend roundups.

## Quizzes, Games & Interactive
- [Quizzes](https://www.buzzfeed.com/quizzes): Main directory for BuzzFeed's personality and trivia quizzes.
- [Trending Quizzes](https://www.buzzfeed.com/trending/quizzes): Popular and currently viral quizzes across the platform.
- [Quiz Party](https://www.buzzfeed.com/quizparty): Multiplayer quiz experiences designed for groups and sharing.
- [Arcade](https://www.buzzfeed.com/arcade): Casual games and puzzle-style interactive content.
- [Showdown](https://www.buzzfeed.com/topic/showdown): Head-to-head voting, rankings, and comparison-style interactives.
- [Trivia](https://www.buzzfeed.com/topic/trivia): Trivia-focused quizzes and knowledge-based challenges.

## Food & Tasty
- [Tasty](https://www.buzzfeed.com/tasty): BuzzFeed's food brand featuring recipes, videos, and cooking ideas.
- [Recipes](https://www.buzzfeed.com/tasty/recipes): Recipe collection covering meals, desserts, and snacks.
- [Tasty Videos](https://www.buzzfeed.com/videos/tasty): Food videos, cooking demonstrations, and recipe clips.
- [Food](https://www.buzzfeed.com/food): Broader food coverage including trends, lists, and cooking stories.
- [Healthy Recipes](https://www.buzzfeed.com/tasty/healthy): Health-conscious recipes and lighter meal ideas.
- [Desserts](https://www.buzzfeed.com/tasty/desserts): Dessert recipes, baking ideas, and sweet treats.

## Lifestyle & Identity
- [As Is](https://www.buzzfeed.com/asis): Lifestyle content focused on identity, wellness, and everyday experiences.
- [Style](https://www.buzzfeed.com/style): Fashion, beauty, and personal style coverage.
- [Health](https://www.buzzfeed.com/health): Wellness, mental health, and health-related explainers.
- [Parents](https://www.buzzfeed.com/parents): Parenting stories, humor, and family-focused content.
- [Nifty](https://www.buzzfeed.com/nifty): DIY, home hacks, crafts, and practical lifestyle ideas.
- [Travel](https://www.buzzfeed.com/travel): Travel inspiration, destination lists, and trip-related stories.

## Shopping & Recommendations
- [Shopping](https://www.buzzfeed.com/shopping): Main shopping hub for product picks and buying guides.
- [Gift Guides](https://www.buzzfeed.com/shopping/gifts): Gift recommendations for holidays, occasions, and recipients.
- [Amazon Finds](https://www.buzzfeed.com/shopping/amazon): Product roundups and recommendations sourced from Amazon.
- [Home Shopping](https://www.buzzfeed.com/shopping/home): Home goods, decor, and practical household product picks.
- [Beauty Shopping](https://www.buzzfeed.com/shopping/beauty): Beauty products, skincare, and makeup recommendations.
- [Fashion Shopping](https://www.buzzfeed.com/shopping/style): Clothing, accessories, and style-related product guides.

## Video & Social Formats
- [Videos](https://www.buzzfeed.com/videos): Main video index for BuzzFeed-produced video content.
- [As Is Videos](https://www.buzzfeed.com/videos/asis): Lifestyle and identity-focused videos from As/Is.
- [Nifty Videos](https://www.buzzfeed.com/videos/nifty): DIY, craft, and home-improvement video content.
- [Worth It](https://www.buzzfeed.com/worthit): Food and experience-focused franchise content and related stories.
- [Bring Me](https://www.buzzfeed.com/bringme): Travel and experience content with destination-focused features.

## Community & Subscriptions
- [Newsletters](https://www.buzzfeed.com/newsletters): Directory of BuzzFeed email newsletters and subscription options.
- [BuzzFeed Community](https://www.buzzfeed.com/community): User-generated posts, stories, and creator-submitted content.
- [BuzzFeed Contributors](https://www.buzzfeed.com/community/contributors): Contributor area for community authors and creators.
- [BuzzFeed App](https://www.buzzfeed.com/app): Information about BuzzFeed's mobile app experience.
- [RSS / Feeds](https://www.buzzfeed.com/about/rss): RSS feed access for BuzzFeed content categories.

## About & Company
- [About BuzzFeed](https://www.buzzfeed.com/about): Company overview, brands, and organizational information.
- [Contact](https://www.buzzfeed.com/about/contact): Contact information and ways to reach BuzzFeed teams.
- [Careers](https://www.buzzfeed.com/about/jobs): Job listings and employment information at BuzzFeed.
- [Advertise](https://www.buzzfeed.com/about/advertise): Advertising and partnership information for brands.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.buzzfeed.com/about/privacy): Privacy practices and data-handling policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.buzzfeed.com/about/useragreement): Terms governing use of BuzzFeed services.
